$comment: Path freezes, enforced by scripts/agents/freeze.mjs (the dispatcher refuses task and maintain work on frozen paths; `node scripts/agents/freeze.mjs` refuses a push or PR). Read from the integration branch, so a branch cannot lift its own freeze. Each entry: {"id": "F-1", "globs": ["supabase/migrations/**"], "until": "YYYY-MM-DD" (exclusive: lifts at 00:00 UTC that day) or an ISO time, "reason": "plain words", "decided_by": "D-nnn"}. Every field is required. An invalid file fails closed. Expired entries are ignored and may be deleted.
